deathDayLines.line: — DAY 5 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Overnight, unknown shoots went bad — beyond saving. You leave it for the flies.
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
🔥 Ruby says it at the fire, not quite looking at Vasyl: “Your past story doesn’t add up. Someone had to say it.” The fire goes quiet in the way it does when someone’s decided to be brave.

Vasyl is quiet for a long moment. Then, all in a rush: “Fine. It’s true. Not Denver — Lviv, Ukraine. I lied because the truth felt small.” The admission hangs there, and the village — to its credit — doesn’t pounce.
People bring you their suspicions, written down. You keep every one.
Dawn. You wake rested. (+3 health, energy restored. By the fire. Good enough.)
You are full enough.
The pantry is in the hall. Your hands are not.
No risky water to boil.
Drank clean water.
Jae hesitates, then backs off. "Not today. Sorry." (Low trust — reluctant.)

A person, maybe 50s stopped asking. They just started organizing the Fetch water crews. Nobody stopped them.
You catch fragments by the fire — Ella telling Sam about you. Three retellings in, nobody remembers what actually happened — but everyone has opinions.

— Under the canopy —
Old growth. The canopy closes overhead and the light comes down in shafts. Something rustled, and decided not to be seen.

◈ CRISIS — THE FIRST GRAVE. Jae is dead. The village digs its first grave, and everyone understands at once: this place can kill you. It just did.

Hunger gnaws. The pack is thin — work the green, haul it back, get it named at camp. That's the whole game.
